_about: The ONE ladder file every game reads (S13-A1; the kit review F3, Zafar 26 Oct): js/shared/tokens.js loads it (Tokens.ladder) for js/shared/guide.js and Cook (js/cook/station-lib.js, js/cook/mechanics/thread.js). No game keeps a copy; build/lint/static.mjs 'hintwait' fails on a second table. rulesFile: the central rules (SH-155, Zafar 29 Oct: data/rules.json, read only through js/shared/rules.js), which js/shared/tokens.js loads with this file.
_help: S08-W1 (the help ladder, SH-60 SH-95): the hint wait (how long the child must have done nothing, counted from the LAST action, before the guide helps, by level 1-4) is the central rules' (SH-155: data/rules.json levels.hintS, 7, 9, 11, 13 s); js/shared/tokens.js fills Tokens.ladder.helpMs from it. The bulb and bulb-pulse times went with the bulbs (Zafar, 6 Nov: 'remove the bulbs from everywhere ... replaced by chai's method').
